itinerary.description: Morning drive to Kappil beach and lake estuary. Visit historic 17th-century Anjengo Fort and lighthouse. Return transfer to Trivandrum Airport or Railway Station with comfortable cab service.

itinerary.description: Full day enjoying the scenic banks of Lidder River, horse riding to Baisaran (Mini Switzerland), and pine forest strolls.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar Mughal Gardens
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar. Visit Shankaracharya Temple, Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi. Shopping for Pashmina and walnut woodcraft.

itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Srinagar Airport for your onward flight with unforgettable memories of Kashmir.
